tldr: Lilith in Libra: the untamed in relationship and the refusal to perform niceness
body: Lilith in Libra: the untamed in relationship and the refusal to perform niceness. Where you reclaim honest desire over keeping the peace. Watch: provocation in partnership. Refusal to keep the peace at your own cost: you reject forced harmony and unfair niceness. A longing for an ideal, near-perfect union and a sharp read on partners, paired with high expectations and a private uncertainty that can make relationships harder than they need to be, even magnifying tensions into self-fulfilling ones. The growth is learning when to speak and when to let be, and turning the relational gift toward genuine collaboration.
business: Owned, this names imbalance and demands real fairness.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes resentful people-pleasing; unchecked, combativeness dressed as fairness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
